svg.font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The eight agentic patterns
svg.desc: Eight named panels, each showing the shape of one agentic pattern without its detail. Augmented LLM: one call with three things beneath it. Durable Agent: the same, with a workflow and a call inside a band. Prompt Chaining: three calls in a row with a gate after the first that can exit early. Evaluator-Optimizer: two calls passing work round a loop. Autonomous Agent: a call exchanging with both the caller and the world outside it. Parallelization: three calls at once, gathered by one. Routing: one call choosing between three. Orchestrator-Workers: one call planning three and one writing them up. Each pattern is drawn in full further down the page.
